production.command: cp .swcrc.production .swcrc.build && node ../../scripts/bin-run.mjs @nestjs/cli/bin/nest build --builder swc --config .swcrc.build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),walk=d=>{fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).forEach(e=>{const p=path.join(d,e.name);e.isDirectory()?walk(p):e.name.endsWith('.map')&&fs.unlinkSync(p)})};walk('dist')" && rm -f .swcrc.build
